HomeHeroTitle: Shared tasks, identical on every device
HomeHeroText: Cadence keeps your team's list in the same state on your laptop, tablet and phone. An edit reaches your other devices instantly, the encryption keys stay with you, and every change lands in an audit log.
HomeHeroNote: Free for teams of up to five. No card needed.

HomeFeatureEncText: Keys never leave your devices. Our servers only hold encrypted blocks, and we cannot read them.
HomeFeatureEuText: Your data lives in EU data centres. You can export the whole archive yourself, without contacting support.
HomeFeatureAuditText: Who changed what and when, for every task. The log exports in full for internal audits.
